observations: Photo 0 and photo 1: one industrial lockstitch (straight stitch) sewing machine head mounted on a white industrial table with metal legs, thread stand and knee lift.
Photo 0 and photo 1: 'EMEL' badge on the machine arm; a small label on the arm front reads 'EM 8500'.
Photo 0 and photo 1: a clutch motor is mounted under the table, with an OFF/ON switch box at the right of the table.
Photo 0 and photo 1: an EMEL 'CLUTCH MOTOR' carton sits on the floor beside the stand; a red EMEL foot pedal mat is under the table.
Paint and table top look clean with no visible rust or damage; machine shown static, nothing shows it sewing.
No receipt, warranty card, or stitching sample is shown. A 'Posted on Jiji' watermark is on both photos.

identity.kind: industrial straight stitch sewing machine with table and clutch motor

claims.evidence: Clean finish is consistent with light use, but no receipt or date is shown.
Only still photos of the machine at rest; no clip of it sewing.
Photos 0 and 1 show clean paint, clean table top and no visible wear or rust.
Internal history cannot be seen in photos.
No receipt or warranty card is shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Machine may not sew cleanly: skipped stitches, timing off, or motor/clutch fault.
risks.proof: A clip with the motor switched on, sewing a straight seam on fabric, then a close-up of the stitch on both sides.

risks.risk: Clutch motor under the table may be weak, noisy or faulty, or the carton beside it may be an empty box rather than a spare motor.
risks.proof: A clip of the motor running with the switch on, and a shot inside the carton.
risks.if_unproven: as one machine set with a faulty motor, carton counted as empty

risks.risk: Age and ownership not proven; may be older than one year or not the seller's to sell.
risks.proof: A photo of the receipt and warranty card with a handwritten code and today's date beside them.
risks.if_unproven: as used of unknown age, no warranty

risks.risk: Missing accessories (bobbin case, bobbins, presser feet, belt).
risks.proof: A close-up of the bed with the slide plate open showing the bobbin case, and a shot under the table showing the belt.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine running and sewing a seam on fabric, with a handwritten code with today's date in shot.
Close-up of the finished stitch on both sides of the fabric.
Photo of the receipt and warranty card.
Close-up of the model label and any serial plate on the machine head.
Shot under the table showing the motor plate and belt, and inside the carton on the floor.
response.reason: Brand and model are readable on the machine head in both photos, so it can be priced as an EMEL EM 8500 industrial straight stitch set at its worst case, as not working, until a sewing clip proves it.
